api: validate(log: str) -> {status: PASS, cases: sorted(required names), scope: software-module-and-verifier}; invalid logs raise ValueError
negative_boundary: DENY is a verifier/helper-filter diagnostic for a syntactically valid compiled full struct_ops object on a prepared module/type/BTF kernel; compiler/ELF/BTF/module/setup failures never satisfy DENY
